# Eden Observability

> Drop-in LLM observability for AI agents: traces, evals, and reviewable fix plans in one loop. OpenAI-compatible gateway and SDKs.

Eden (edenobservability.com) helps teams see every agent run and fix what fails. Use this index to find product pages and documentation.

## Product

- [Home](https://edenobservability.com/): Product overview — LLM observability and improvement for AI agents
- [Pricing](https://edenobservability.com/pricing): Plans and pricing
- [Why Eden](https://edenobservability.com/why-eden): Product positioning and when to choose Eden
- [About](https://edenobservability.com/about): Company and product background
- [Changelog](https://edenobservability.com/changelog): Product release notes
- [Security](https://edenobservability.com/security): Security posture and vulnerability disclosure

## Intent guides

- [AI agent observability](https://edenobservability.com/ai-agent-observability): What agent observability is and why traces alone are not enough
- [OpenAI-compatible gateway](https://edenobservability.com/openai-compatible-gateway): Gateway positioning, overhead, gateway vs SDK
- [OpenTelemetry LLM tracing](https://edenobservability.com/opentelemetry-llm-tracing): OTel ingest for LLM and agent apps
- [LLM observability tools](https://edenobservability.com/llm-observability-tools): Roundup by category — traces, evals, gateways, closed-loop
- [Langfuse alternatives](https://edenobservability.com/langfuse-alternatives): Evaluation criteria and shortlist (complements vs Langfuse)
- [Helicone alternatives](https://edenobservability.com/helicone-alternatives): Proxy-first buyer guide (complements vs Helicone)
